create_omat24_static_vasp_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 PBE static calculation using OMat24StaticSet with a pymatgen Structure
create_omat24_relaxation_vasp_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 PBE relaxation calculation using OMat24RelaxSet with IBRION 2 and ISIF 3
create_omat24_aimd_vasp_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 AIMD simulation using OMat24AIMDSet with configurable temperature and thermostat
configure_omat24_aimd_ensemble: configure the OMat24AIMDSet ensemble to nvt or npt with nose or langevin thermostat options
review_omat24_incar_updates: review the incar_updates property on OMat24RelaxSet and OMat24AIMDSet to inspect VASP INCAR parameter overrides
